about: The ceiling of the water under a cycle of the room: the room stays at 21.1 (under a target of 22, warm inside its band), a Light at 40 s lights the burner, and the water climbs past its setpoint of 60 (at about 277 s): the cycle ends there with the room still cold, and the fire goes the ordinary way down - it does not burn on to the overheating.
